review_reason: Phase A discovery: making Modal.Proposition.diamond a primitive constructor breaks a definitional identity relied on structurally (not just notationally) by Cslib/Logics/Modal/Metalogic/** (MCS.lean, Completeness.lean, DerivationTree.lean) and Cslib/Logics/Modal/ProofSystem/Instances/{B,TB,KB5,S5,DB}.lean -- none of which are in the plan's stated consumer set. Fixing the canonical-model (MCS/Completeness) layer requires either new axiomatic infrastructure (HasDia + AxiomDiaDualityFwd/Back across ~9 modal systems) or a substantial restatement with new proof content (a native-diamond canonical-model existence lemma), both of which are design decisions requiring sign-off before an implementation agent proceeds. All working-tree changes were reverted; the repo is clean and green at HEAD ebd6bb1d.

artifacts.summary: Full account of the Phase A investigation: which of the plan's 5 target files were fully drafted and individually verified green (Basic.lean, LogicalEquivalence.lean, ModalEmbedding.lean, Denotation.lean, FromPropositional.lean), the mechanical axiom-schema fix that also worked (DerivationTree.lean + ProofSystem/Instances/{B,TB,KB5,DB}.lean via the canonical Axioms.AxiomB abbrev), and the precise non-mechanical blocker in Metalogic/Completeness.lean + MCS.lean's canonical-model proofs that do syntactic surgery on the diamond term's structure. Includes file:line references and a recommendation to re-plan before resuming.

blockers.description: Native diamond breaks structural/definitional assumptions in Cslib/Logics/Modal/Metalogic/{MCS,Completeness,DerivationTree}.lean and ProofSystem/Instances/{B,TB,KB5,S5,DB}.lean -- outside the plan's scoped consumer set. Requires a design decision (new HasDia axiomatic infrastructure vs. raw-encoding restatement) before implementation can proceed without inventing unscoped mathematics.

Cslib/Logics/Modal/Tableau/FmpMeasure.lean (3011 lines) and CompletenessLoop.lean (1096 lines) were added by tasks 442/462 after this plan was written and are not in any phase's file list, despite depending pervasively on the Lukasiewicz decomposers (modalNegOf?/modalOrOf?/modalAndOf?/modalImpOf?/modalDiaOf?) that Phase B is meant to replace.
